description: This file provides the authentication context and hooks for managing user authentication state within a React application using Supabase. It defines context, provider component, and custom hooks for authentication actions like sign-in, sign-out, and role retrieval.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context to its children, managing session state and authentication actions.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access the authentication context, throws error if used outside provider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Custom hook to retrieve the current user's role from session metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useAuth for backward compatibility or alternative import.
